note: Per-site verdicts for db/gates/check-renamed-column-consumers.mjs gate 2. This REPLACED a hardcoded stoplist of common English column names, which suppressed the very class the gate exists to catch. Never add a name filter to quiet the gate -- adjudicate the site. CORRECTED 2026-08-06 -- the original verdict was WRONG in its reasoning and incomplete in its scope, and the defect it missed shipped. It read: libs-server/get-roster.mjs:47 explicitly aliases transactions.player_salary as value, so roster_entry.value reads are correct. That reasons from ONE producer to a whole consumer class. The second producer of the Roster constructor, libs-server/get-league-rosters-from-database.mjs:51, selected transactions.player_salary with no alias, so every player arrived with value: undefined, availableCap summed to NaN, and NaN || 0 at libs-shared/roster.mjs:97 collapsed it to 0 -- every team rendered the raw $200 cap as its salary space. The reviewer could not have found it from this gate: gate 2 anchors its candidate set on db(<table>) FROM-target literals, and that file reaches transactions through .leftJoin off db(rosters_players), so it is not in the 36 sites listed above and never could have been. This entry stands as already-swept for the sites it names, which are correctly adjudicated. The JOIN blind spot is tracked in user:task/league/collapse-column-alias-layer-and-gate-rename-residue.md; do not read this verdict as covering any producer reached through a join. SECOND CORRECTION 2026-08-06, after the value -> player_salary migration (8643dc8a7, 33721c0b9) swept the class for real: the original reason's closing clause -- Every other .value read is req.body, a socket message, a cookie/Set/Map, or the data-views param DSL -- was FALSE when written, and it is the exact assertion league CLAUDE.md forbids, because this entry records QUERY sites and can say nothing about read sites the reviewer did not open. At 62ca45544 app/core/rosters/reducer.js:28 already destructured value off a transaction row on the LOAD_ROSTERS path, and the migration went on to find TEN live consumer sites in total, six of them (app/core/selectors.js get_cutlist_total_salary, the restricted-free-agency-confirmation charge, settings-teams-team, check-restricted-free-agency-salary-cap-violations, scripts/process-projections.mjs, libs-server/roster-asset-lineage/walk-transactions.mjs) surviving a full suite that was GREEN at 3304 passing. Treat this entry as settling the query sites listed above and NOTHING else.
